lark_e09_entry.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry.text: Shan Lu left on Day Sixty Eight with the four day visit received as it had actually been offered. Her return fare paid the ordinary lower road coach, which did not use the freight gallery's newly reduced support. Shan Fang carried her bundle to the departure place and came back holding nothing but Qin Yi's spare drawing. The child had made two copies so one could remain at home. Lin watched the sisters finish their embrace before the coach's keeper called the passengers. A good departure still hurt the people who had planned it sensibly.

lark_e09_entry_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_002.text: Lin kept her third ordinary assessment that morning. Five copper paid the current clinician's accepted examination, making fifteen spent from the forty copper assessment portion and twenty five still available. Her low movement had improved again. A higher reach remained unreliable, and the clinician kept the current overhead restriction. He wanted the coming practice to preserve its support position. Lin said the fifth pair was not yet complete. He said that was useful information about instruction, but his ordinary tissue examination would still have to answer the shoulder's own question.

lark_e09_entry_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_003.text: Duan's sixth received teaching meeting followed after the ordinary recovery interval named in the plan. Lin used the supported low task and the current checked board. The first fifth pair movement repeated, with its grounded release received independently. The second carried more of its small useful task before interruption but did not reach the stated result. Duan marked what changed and what did not. Four copper paid the completed meeting, leaving fourteen formal meetings and fifty six copper. Lin did not turn improvement at a difficult movement into permission to use it on freight.

lark_e09_entry_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_004.text: The reduced gallery load had already changed the market. Two carriers had to split jobs that formerly travelled in one receiving. Their accepted revised prices included the extra turn. A seller who could not afford the second turn brought fewer jars uphill and sold out before noon. The empty place on her stall looked like success until she explained how many customers she had sent elsewhere. Lin heard the difference from the woman herself. A safety limit could be necessary and still cost the person obeying it real trade she could not recover by applauding the crew.

lark_e09_entry_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_005.text: Qin's lighter booking had been completed under its revised fee. He had no authority to compensate himself by adding another crate to the reduced rating. He came to the shrine room with a list of next week's possible jobs and asked Shan Fang which evenings they could actually fit. Qin Yi wanted every job scheduled outside every performance she might someday invent. Her mother said they would need the performances' actual dates first. Lin sat with her glove and watched a family's livelihood refuse to organize itself around an infinite calendar.

lark_e09_entry_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_006.text: Chen Rui arrived at the market with a public presentation request from his client. The client had remade the sample joint and wanted to demonstrate the visible warning method beside a stopped inspection light. Rao Ji's proposed observation on Day Sixty Nine could supply a qualified talisman operator under actual conditions. The association had agreed to consider a public session; it had not endorsed a sale. Chen delivered the request to Hu Lan before discussing it with Lin. His own desire for a successful appointment did not give him authority to combine two people's offered work.

lark_e09_entry_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_007.text: Hu Lan asked the qualified crew what could be shown without opening licensed dimensions or bringing power onto the public stair. They offered a bench isolated from the freight signal. Rao would operate a small rated inspection talisman for the permitted four breath demonstration, with ordinary rest and a stopped grounded release. The supplier would show its own remade sample. The external fuel and backing would come from the supplier's declared demonstration stock, not Lin's practice allotment or the association's bell reserve. Lin was invited as an observer whose presence implied no personal realm transfer.

lark_e09_entry_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_008.text: On Day Sixty Nine, Rao arrived after a current recovery check. His knee allowed the low supported seated task. He did not declare a whole day of standing work by pointing to the recovered six pair record. Hu Lan read the limited public demonstration scope before the sample was placed on the bench. Lin sat where she could see both the contact board and the ordinary disconnect. The crowd remained behind the marked line. Qin Yi wanted the light to be green and was told that its permitted color concerned the backing, not her preference.

lark_e09_entry_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_009.text: The supplier fitter inspected the remade holes and showed the public stamp identifying this sample. It was not the imperfect object from the earlier comparison. Chen placed the old and new public drawings side by side and named the revision without announcing that every future manufactured fitting would therefore be sound. The old discrepancy could be admitted plainly because nobody here had installed that sample on the freight bell. Lin noticed how much easier the truth became when a postponed sale was still allowed to remain postponed.

lark_e09_entry_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_010.text: Rao began the prepared primary task below its tested input ceiling. Across four ordinary breaths, the small talisman's light held at the fixed contact under its rated backing and pigment. Its useful output remained a quarter unit within the accepted half unit input ceiling, with no breath exceeding an eighth. The talisman did not make the whole gallery glow. It did not draw a new route through Lin's observing body. At the named interruption, Rao released into the grounded wick and the light went out before the fitter moved the sample.

lark_e09_entry_011.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_011.text: Lin could see the difference between his practiced release and her uncertain second fifth pair movement. He had no need to hurry the useful result before somebody noticed its fragility. When Hu Lan changed the public demonstration's ordinary order, he paused, checked the stated task, and performed only the part received under the same scope. He refused an audience request to keep the light burning while the crowd dispersed. The current task had tested four breaths, not an open ended display. A competent refusal made the demonstration less spectacular and more useful.

lark_e09_entry_012.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_012.text: The fitter opened the sample's cover after the task had stopped and shown its ordinary resting state. He demonstrated the visible warning line through unpowered movements. Lin watched the loose cover condition repeated alongside the intended stop movement. The public instructions could tell a reader to report the changed line without diagnosing the hidden geometry. A man in the crowd asked whether the new fitting would prevent an avalanche. Hu Lan answered before the supplier could benefit from the question: no signal joint held up the mountainside or replaced the crew's evacuation work.

lark_e09_entry_013.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_013.text: The question stayed with Lin because it was so easy to hear the wish beneath it. People wanted a thing they could buy that would turn a mountain's uncertain future into a safe receipt. The remade joint could offer an inspection improvement under proper installation and service. That was smaller than protection from every danger, and worth considering on its own. Chen repeated the narrower claim in his client's public presentation. Lin saw him choose the sentence that might sell fewer fittings while leaving buyers less dangerously reassured.

lark_e09_entry_014.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_014.text: After the demonstration, the supplier offered Lin a paid public statement about what she had observed. Its first draft called her a promising six pair practitioner. She had four established pairs and an incomplete fifth. The drafter had mistaken a future course for a present result, or had preferred the sound of the mistake. Lin crossed out the phrase in front of Chen and Hu Lan. Neither defended it. The supplier could request her ordinary observation. It could not purchase a stage she had not earned for the sake of a longer line of print.

lark_e09_entry_015.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_015.text: The proposed statement concerned the visible warning and the stopped four breath light task. Lin could describe those observations as a fifth stage student present at the session, not as the joint's independent installation examiner. The supplier offered five copper from its current presentation purse after a corrected signed statement was actually printed in the received public notice. The payment would be disclosed on that notice. Hu Lan could instead receive an unpaid bounded observation for the association's own file. Lin could also decline either new writing task and retain only her observer's knowledge.

lark_e09_entry_016.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_016.text: Accepting the paid statement would place her name and the supplier's five copper beside a public technical conclusion. Its narrow wording might be useful to readers, but people could later question how payment affected it. A private keeper record would give qualified receiving people her observations without public endorsement or fee. Declining would let the crew and Rao's actual record carry the demonstration alone. Nobody claimed her signature was needed to keep the warning safe. The public installation decision still belonged to the competent crew and the association's licensed permissions.

lark_e09_entry_017.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_017.text: Chen told her his client preferred the signed public statement and admitted why. A named student who had questioned its first sample looked like an independent voice to buyers. Lin asked whether he wanted her to appear independent without disclosing the fee. He said no and pointed to the printed payment line the corrected proposal now included. He was willing to help place the statement if she accepted. He would not treat her refusal as a broken friendship. His words mattered less than the fact that the refusal form stayed beside the paid invitation without being quietly removed.

lark_e09_entry_018.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_entry_018.text: Lin read the corrected text aloud. It named the actual sample, the public task, and the limit that a warning was a reason to seek inspection rather than permission to continue. It said no new fitting had yet been installed on the freight bell. It did not publish private dimensions, bodily route diagrams, or household claims. The proposed deadline was Day Seventy Three. That gave her time to check the public wording, not to pretend an unperformed future installation had already confirmed it. She would choose whether to put her name, time, and possible fee into that record.

lark_e09_signature_choice.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_choice.text: The corrected invitations lay open. Lin could accept the disclosed five copper statement and place her name in a permanent public notice; she could deliver the same bounded observations only to the association keeper without pay; or she could decline further writing and leave the qualified demonstration's existing record to speak for itself. Each choice would determine what later readers could actually ask her about.

choices.text: Publish the bounded signed statement with its five copper fee disclosed.
Deliver an unpaid bounded observation only to the keeper's file.
Decline either writing task and retain no new endorsement obligation.

lark_e09_signature_open.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_open.text: Lin accepted the paid public statement under the corrected terms. She signed only after the invitation included the disclosed fee and the actual fifth stage description. The supplier's drafter took the accepted copy to prepare a public notice, with final receiving still required. Lin kept a permitted identical copy. Chen watched the handoff and did not call it a promise of sales. Hu Lan entered the association's unchanged installation status beside the statement date. Lin's name would now travel in a public technical sentence that could not be recalled merely by regretting the attention it received.

lark_e09_signature_open_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_open_002.text: On Day Seventy Two, Lin inspected the prepared notice at the supplier's temporary stall. The heading still called the session a bench demonstration. A smaller line named the sample number and printed the five copper statement fee. The first draft had moved the warning limit onto a back page. Lin required it beside the observation before she would receive the publication. The drafter complained about space. She offered a shorter account of the crowd instead of a shorter limit on the conclusion. The public copy lost an attractive sentence about eager mountain households.

lark_e09_signature_open_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_open_003.text: Chen supported that revision, though his client had liked the sentence. The notice's purpose was to carry a useful claim to people who had not attended the session. Those readers would be harmed more by a missing condition than helped by a description of enthusiasm. The drafter moved the line and showed Lin the new proof. She read it from beginning to end. Her name remained attached to the bounded stopped task, not to a guarantee that the freight bell or gallery had become safe under a fitting that was still uninstalled.

lark_e09_signature_open_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_open_004.text: The corrected notice was actually posted on Day Seventy Three after Hu Lan received its public status line. Lin saw the final copy on the lower board and compared it with the accepted text. The printer had reproduced the disclosed payment and the installation limit. She signed the receiving for the completed statement work. Five copper was then paid from the supplier's named presentation purse, outside her employment and instruction allotment. The fee compensated this additional received writing task. It did not alter her four established pairs or buy any part of the future examination.

lark_e09_signature_open_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_open_005.text: An onion seller read the notice and asked whether the paid statement was trustworthy. Lin said payment deserved to be visible, which was why it was printed. She offered the task and sample observations for examination rather than asking the seller to trust her good intentions. The seller read the installation limit and said she cared most that the old bell had not been changed without telling its users. Lin could answer that public fact. She could not promise every reader would separate the statement's narrow conclusion from the louder idea of a supplier buying a student's name.

lark_e09_signature_open_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_open_006.text: Qin found her name while waiting for his ordinary receiving. He said he had not realized observing a light could become extra paid writing. Lin explained what she had actually delivered and what the fee covered. He asked if she would mind him being paid to speak about a basket he had helped return. She said she would want his scope and payment visible as well. He considered the answer without agreeing that it settled every unease. She had chosen a public relationship with a supplier, and her friends were allowed to examine its shape.

lark_e09_signature_open_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_open_007.text: Lin filed the completed statement and its payment receipt separately from the ordinary work roll. The new five copper was hers to spend, with its source no longer deniable. Hu Lan kept the official public status alongside it. Later readers could ask about the exact sample, wording, and disclosed fee. They could not make her a competent gallery examiner because a printer had used her name. She went to the next lesson carrying the useful observation and the permanent public record she had consented to make.

lark_e09_signature_bounded.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_bounded.text: Lin declined the public fee and accepted an unpaid observation for Hu Lan's association file. The keeper named its receiving date as Day Seventy Three. Chen returned the supplier's signature invitation with a clear refusal before the public notice was prepared. The client could use its own observations and qualified records, but not imply that Lin had accepted a paid endorsement. Her chosen work would still take a quiet afternoon. Refusing money did not turn the time she had offered into a task nobody needed to receive.

lark_e09_signature_bounded_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_bounded_002.text: On Day Seventy Two, Lin wrote the bounded observation beside the association's public demonstration record. She separated Rao's stopped light task from the supplier fitter's unpowered warning movements. The public sample number appeared in both places. Its hidden dimensions did not. Hu Lan asked her to identify which part she had actually observed from her seat and which part came from the crew's stated source. Lin could see the light cease at the prepared interruption. She had not inspected every contact beneath the housing merely because she sat near the board.

lark_e09_signature_bounded_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_bounded_003.text: The revised observation used separate sentences for the visible result and the received crew statement. Hu Lan could compare them with the qualified operator's independent record. Lin's account added a particular witness position without pretending to replace the operator's measurements. There was no public performance in getting that distinction right. She sat with the keeper while the ink dried and heard ordinary freight receiving through the shutter. Her name would remain in a working file, attached to what one seated observer could actually say.

lark_e09_signature_bounded_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_bounded_004.text: Hu Lan received the completed observation on Day Seventy Three and signed its narrow acknowledgment. No fee was owed under the accepted unpaid invitation. The supplier posted its own public demonstration notice without Lin's endorsement. Chen brought her the offered public copy so she could check that her refusal had been respected. It named the qualified session and the unchanged installation status, not a student approval that had never been given. Lin found the absence of her name satisfying in a way that surprised her after years of wishing to be recognized.

lark_e09_signature_bounded_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_bounded_005.text: The onion seller asked whether she had signed anything for the supplier. Lin said no, and explained that she had written an observation for the association keeper. The seller could not inspect that file simply because the conversation interested her. Its later disclosure would depend on the keeper's actual authority and scope. She still had access to the ordinary public safety notice and its current installation fact. Lin's choice had preserved a working account for competent receiving people while leaving public buyers without her personal statement to examine.

lark_e09_signature_bounded_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_bounded_006.text: Chen admitted his client was disappointed. The paid named statement would have been useful advertising. He had respected her refusal, and he did not need to conceal the disappointment to prove it. Lin asked whether his fee had changed. It had not; his accepted presentation work had been received separately. The conversation stayed civil without becoming effortless. Friendship had made both the request and the refusal matter more. They could continue to eat together without pretending the two afternoon outcomes had been equally attractive to the business he served.

lark_e09_signature_bounded_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_bounded_007.text: Lin put Hu Lan's acknowledgment in the local work file. The keeper held her detailed observation; she held its receiving, with no supplier payment and no public signature. A later competent inquiry could ask the keeper for the relevant part under proper scope. A passing rumor could not fairly treat her as a printed endorser. The distinction would matter if the demonstration became part of a later argument. For now, it had cost an afternoon and closed with one actual report instead of two imaginary possibilities kept open.

lark_e09_signature_decline.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_decline.text: Lin declined both new writing invitations. Hu Lan marked the answer received, and Chen returned the public statement offer before the supplier prepared its notice. No fee became due, no report date waited for her, and no private observer account entered the association file in her name. The qualified operator and crew already had their own actual demonstration records. Her refusal did not leave the session unmeasured. It left her a person who had attended, learned something bounded, and chosen not to turn that attendance into a second job.

lark_e09_signature_decline_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_decline_002.text: The free afternoon on Day Seventy Two stayed free until she chose an ordinary use for it. She went to the shrine room to mend the glove's other thumb. The first patch had held well enough to make the second worth doing. Shan Fang was teaching her visiting neighbor a seam that would lie flat against a wrist. Lin asked permission to listen and was given a scrap to try. There was no receiving fee or curriculum credit hidden in the company. She could spend a quiet hour on a useful thing without assigning the hour a public reputation.

lark_e09_signature_decline_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_decline_003.text: Qin Yi wanted to know why Lin's name would not be on the supplier's notice. The child liked the possibility of recognizing somebody in print. Lin said she had been offered a writing task and had declined it. She could not honestly say it was unworthy work, because a bounded statement might have helped readers. She had chosen not to take on its fee and public questioning. The child thought public questioning sounded like grown people refusing to play chestnut games until somebody explained every rule. Lin admitted the comparison had some merit.

lark_e09_signature_decline_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_decline_004.text: On Day Seventy Three, the supplier's actual public notice appeared without her endorsement. It named its own sample and the qualified session's received public facts. Chen brought Lin a copy because she had asked to see that her refusal remained clear. Her name was absent. The ordinary safety notice still said no new fitting had been installed on the freight bell. Lin could explain that public status to a reader without claiming authorship of the supplier's publication. The afternoon she had kept had not purchased a right to disregard what the notice actually said.

lark_e09_signature_decline_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_decline_005.text: The onion seller asked whether Lin could tell her how the hidden comparison had gone. Lin could not supply a detailed record she had not accepted permission to retain or report. She described only the visible public task she had attended and directed the installation question to Hu Lan. The seller found that less convenient than an answer across the market counter. Lin let the inconvenience stay real. Declining additional work had kept her time available and left other people to seek some answers from the competent records that actually existed.

lark_e09_signature_decline_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_decline_006.text: Chen said the client's notice would have been stronger advertising with her name. Lin asked whether he meant more accurate or more persuasive. He smiled unwillingly and said more persuasive. The corrected narrow statement could have been accurate as well, but she had declined the offered role. He did not ask her to reconsider after the date closed. They shared a bowl from the same stall and discussed the price of ordinary winter buckles. A friendship could contain a missed business advantage without becoming either a broken alliance or an automatic promise to make up for it later.

lark_e09_signature_decline_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_signature_decline_007.text: Lin retained the permitted public copy and no payment receipt. She had not written the association's detailed observer report either. A future inquiry would need the qualified session record and whatever ordinary recollection she could offer within its actual limits. She could not borrow the private file she had declined to create when a difficult question arrived. The kept afternoon and the missing documentation were both consequences of the same answer. She placed the public sheet behind her other dated notices and went back to the work she had actually accepted.

lark_e09_after_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_001.text: The gallery's new limits stayed in force while the supplier's notice travelled through the market. A posted statement could not make the moving support stop moving. The qualified crew found that the nearby joints needed bracing and continued observation before the ordinary rating could be restored. The association kept the reduced load rather than announcing that a completed commercial comparison had solved a different structural problem. Qin adjusted his next bookings through their actual keepers. The changed work remained less convenient than the old route, which did not make the inspection an enemy of the people paying its cost.

lark_e09_after_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_002.text: Lin's initial six week primary role ended on Day Sixty Nine. Its copying, walking comparison, or dispatch work had occupied actual received shifts under the selected schedule. The keeper offered the same finite place's remaining ordinary shifts as a source comparison assistant at the lower desk, with low seated and standing tasks inside her present limits. Lin accepted that new local assignment for the remaining term. The earlier roles stayed with their current keepers. She did not acquire all three by moving on, and nobody reopened the first week's applicant observations as unpaid continuing obligations.

lark_e09_after_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_003.text: The sixteenth shift was received on Day Sixty Nine before the talisman session, adding four copper and bringing Lin's wages to sixty four. On Day Seventy, the next weekly meal and lodging provision was received, making thirty five copper over seven actual weeks. The ordinary desk role began after the old schedule closed. Her paid work would still be received one completed six hour shift at a time. The new room had a lower writing surface and a window that faced a wall rather than the ravine. Lin found the reduced view unexpectedly restful.

lark_e09_after_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_004.text: The evacuation materials arrived on Day Seventy under the already approved sixty copper category. Thirty two paid for the inspected timber delivered into association custody, eight for four ordinary canvas rolls at two each, and four for the two received sets of public notices. The remaining sixteen paid the accepted qualified crew sessions only after their actual work. These materials belonged to the evacuation task and its keeper. They were not Lin's new training kit, and they did not give the supplier permission to substitute its fitting for the crew's structural plan.

lark_e09_after_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_005.text: Two qualified workers began the first of their two accepted six hour sessions that day, at four copper per completed session each. Lin visited during her own free afternoon after the keeper accepted an observation position clear of their work. The timber's clean pale faces looked more reassuring than the old gallery supports. One worker turned a piece and showed a twisted grain beneath the surface. It could still serve in the named low brace, but not where a visitor might casually have placed it for the longest reach. Newness was not a rating.

lark_e09_after_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_006.text: The second worker checked the delivered lengths against the actual receiving list. A short piece had been bundled beside a longer one, obscuring its end. The timber seller's keeper accepted the mismatch and sent the correct piece before installation. The qualified workers used the delay to prepare an ordinary joint on the bench rather than build a structure from a length they wished they had received. Lin watched the replaced piece arrive through its proper carrier. There was no secret generosity in the correction; the seller had agreed to deliver that length for the price already paid.

lark_e09_after_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_007.text: The crew placed the first brace beside an existing evacuation landing, within the structural scope already inspected. It did not turn the shelter into a cargo depot. A carrier wanted to stack two waiting crates beneath the new rail because the space looked protected. The keeper refused and pointed to the occupancy passage kept clear by the plan. Lin helped read the posted distinction to the man. He moved the crates to their accepted waiting place at his own booking's instruction. A stronger looking rail could attract precisely the use the crew had never rated it to bear.

lark_e09_after_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_008.text: Shan Fang came to see the notices before mending visitors used the changed evening route. She cared less about the carpenter's neat joint than about whether a woman carrying a sleeve basket would understand where to wait. One notice placed the closed branch below its arrow. She read the arrow first and walked toward the wrong turn on the unpowered demonstration sheet. The notice writer corrected the heading before posting the received set. Four copper had bought readable route notices as an actual task, not paper whose mistakes became harmless because the price was small.

lark_e09_after_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_009.text: The first two qualified sessions were received at their sixth hour, paying eight copper from the sixteen crew portion. The second pair of sessions was scheduled for Day Seventy Three. Lin did not receive a wage for her observation, and her ordinary shift remained on its own dates. She went to the shrine room with the memory of a woman reading the wrong arrow and a worker rejecting the wrong timber. Both errors had been found before the new landing opened under its revised plan. Neither required someone to pretend the people involved were foolish or corrupt.

lark_e09_after_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_010.text: Duan's seventh formal meeting took place on Day Seventy One. Lin's fifth pair completed its second small useful movement under the accepted low supported task for the first time. She stopped, discharged, and rested without immediately extending it to a different range. Duan changed the task order after the recovery interval. The second movement then faltered. The first success remained a received practice result, and the changed order showed work still missing. The pair was not stable across the needed conditions. Four copper paid the meeting, leaving thirteen formal meetings and fifty two copper.

lark_e09_after_011.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_011.text: The practice keeper had purchased the first small fuel pack for two copper at the initial board meeting, and a second accepted pack now brought practice fuel purchases to four of the twenty four allocated copper. The packs' prices did not describe Lin's reserve. Jiang measured the actual board condition and sampling discharge under its own method. Lin wrote the new changed order failure below the completed movement. She could not average the two into a successful qualification. One task had worked once; another had failed when the ordinary sequence changed.

lark_e09_after_012.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_012.text: At the lodging, she wanted to tell somebody that the second movement had finally happened. She also wanted to avoid the sentence about its failure afterward. The two wishes made a poor letter. Lin waited until after supper, then wrote her mother both results in ordinary language. The fifth pair was developing, and the sixth had not begun. She included the mending room's ghost song and the visitor's sensible four day return. Her mother would receive a life with work in it, not a procession of partial victories arranged to look like a certificate.

lark_e09_after_013.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_013.text: Chen bought a repaired buckle from the stall Lin had recommended. He showed her the receipt because she had teased him about buying the most persuasive drawing rather than the soundest object. The buckle's seller had let him fit it to his own strap before paying. He said she had made the sale seem undramatic enough to trust. Lin asked whether his client would appreciate that compliment. He said the client might, when it had a working service proposal and no need to persuade buyers that a warning fitting could hold up a mountain.

lark_e09_after_014.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_014.text: He had sent the client a account of the postponed installation. Its reply thanked him for finding a priceable tool requirement and asked him to continue the next authorized comparison. That was a real small success in his paid work. It did not prove every future employer would reward such restraint. Lin congratulated him for the received reply rather than describing honesty as a guarantee of business. He sat with her while the lodging keeper served tea. For an hour, they could be two people glad about a buckle and a letter.

lark_e09_after_015.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_015.text: Rao joined them by invitation. His knee had tolerated the small seated demonstration but not the longer afternoon walk he had hoped to make. He used the lower stair and refused to call that a defeat. Lin asked how much practice had made his interrupted release look so easy. He said he had once made it look difficult in three different ways at the same bench. Chen wanted to know whether any of those ways had involved a fashionable shoe. Rao had not heard Duan's story and was delighted by the possibility of a teacher being outbid by footwear.

lark_e09_after_016.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_016.text: The conversation turned toward the association's practical comparison session scheduled for Day Seventy Five. Qualified trainees and workers could demonstrate established route tasks under changed ordinary order, with safe withdrawal at every limit. Lin was invited to attempt only her four certified pairs, not the new fifth practice route. Rao would perform under the same stated task conditions after his current recovery check. There was no wager of bodily safety and no promise that the lower stage entrant would win by understanding the mountain better than the people who lived there.

lark_e09_after_017.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_017.text: Rao said he expected to complete the tasks more reliably than Lin. The direct statement startled her more than a boast would have. He had trained longer, carried six stable pairs on recovered tests, and knew this board's permitted changes. He offered no story about her special aptitude that would erase those advantages. Lin asked why she should attend a comparison she was likely to lose. He said losing under a stopped safe task could show her where her current control actually stood. She could decline, but then she would not have that observation to use.

lark_e09_after_018.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_018.text: Duan received the proposed session conditions separately before advising her. It would use the established routes and current ceiling, with ordinary rest between tasks and independent interruption. He did not say she had to win to justify the paid teaching place. He did ask whether she could stop in front of spectators rather than protect a reputation with added strain. Lin had already asked that question in a smaller room. The coming session would ask it where a crowd could mistake a sensible interruption for an inadequate person. That was a different ordinary pressure, worth taking seriously.

lark_e09_after_019.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_019.text: On Day Seventy Three, the qualified crew completed its second pair of six hour sessions and received the remaining eight copper, exhausting the accepted sixteen crew scope. The revised landing and notices were inspected within the actual plan before opening to their stated use. All sixty evacuation copper had now paid received materials, notices, and those bounded crew tasks. The funds did not buy an unlimited future rebuilding crew. The keeper retained the materials inventory and current rating, so a later loss could be named as a real missing piece rather than covered by an imaginary unspent reserve.

lark_e09_after_020.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_020.text: Lin's seventeenth ordinary shift was received that evening, paying four copper and bringing wages to sixty eight. At the lower desk, she had separated a current receiving form from an old sample that a visiting clerk almost used as today's authorization. The clerk was relieved to find the difference before stamping it. Lin could perform that useful task without a fifth pair. Her ordinary employment would not become less real if she lost the technical comparison. She put the shift paper beside the proposed session conditions and found both easier to read together.

lark_e09_after_021.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_021.text: Qin Yi asked whether Rao was going to beat her. Lin said he was likely to do the received tasks more reliably. The child offered to make the audience laugh at his shoe so he would lose concentration. Lin declined the tactic and explained that the session was not a paper play. A person taking a safe test needed the actual conditions, not a hidden helper spoiling somebody else's work. Qin Yi thought this made comparisons less entertaining. Lin said that was probably necessary if the people performing them were going to return to their families with unhurt hands.

lark_e09_after_022.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_022.text: Shan Fang heard the exchange and asked whether Lin wanted anybody she knew in the audience. The presence could be comforting or distracting; she would not choose it for her. Lin said she would welcome someone who understood that a stopped task could be the right result. Shan Fang could attend after her own accepted lesson ended. Qin's freight booking would keep him away, and nobody invented a free hour for him. Qin Yi promised not to shout about shoes. The promise was received with the caution appropriate to a child whose joke still concerned one.

lark_e09_after_023.speaker: narrator
lark_e09_after_023.text: Lin went back to the practice folder before bed. The fifth pair's first completed second movement and its changed order failure remained in their dated places. The gallery's new timber and notices stood under their rating, with no promise that materials could prevent every future force. She would enter the next session as a fifth stage practitioner with four certified pairs and an shoulder restriction.
